title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New Engladn files with the Department of Public Utililities for approval and review a 365-Day Firm Transportation Service Agreement with Bunker Hill Community College.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. Also, the Department finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive and therefore grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul J. Hibbard, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating and Tim Woolf. (DPU 08-GC-7.
